prompts: Game production texture, stylized-concept: one square, perfectly front-facing orthographic seamless tile of very dark weathered cemetery masonry, fills entire opaque image edge to edge, no borders, no text, no margins, no objects, no arches/windows/skulls/symbols. Cold desaturated charcoal blue-green stone, damp abandoned crypt centuries old. Subtle value differences, dark mortar, restrained fine detail, crisp pixel-art-friendly painted stone clusters, flat ambient lighting with no central spotlight or vignette. Approximately four horizontal courses of small rough rectangular stone blocks across the square, each course staggered and irregular lengths. Compatible repeatable top/bottom and left/right boundaries, no outstanding high contrast crack at border. No perspective, no floor perspective. This will be reduced to a 128x128 pixel sprite displayed across 32x32 game-world units. It must read as background structural material, not an ornamental panel. Variant A: broad worn stones with shallow chips, mostly uninterrupted dark faces, minor sparse pitting.
